text.2:75: Have ye any hope that they will be true to you when a party of them used to listen to the word of Allah, then used to change it, after they had understood it, knowingly?
text.5:84: How should we not believe in Allah and that which hath come unto us of the Truth. And (how should we not) hope that our Lord will bring us in along with righteous folk?
text.7:46: Between them is a veil. And on the Heights are men who know them all by their marks. And they call unto the dwellers of the Garden: Peace be unto you! They enter it not although they hope (to enter).
text.26:51: Lo! we ardently hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we are the first of the believers.
text.26:82: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment.
text.33:32: O ye wives of the Prophet! Ye are not like any other women. If ye keep your duty (to Allah), then be not soft of speech, lest he in whose heart is a disease aspire (to you), but utter customary speech.
text.70:38: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?
text.74:15: Yet he desireth that I should give more.
